data.one_liner: Simple linear progress indicators with solid colors and gradients.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable linear progress bar widgets with support for solid colors and gradients. It includes basic progress indicators, automatically animating indicators, and implicitly animated progress bars.
use_when: You need linear progress bars with custom solid colors or gradients.
You want simple entry animations or implicit value-change animations for progress.
avoid_when: You need circular progress indicators, charts, or complex multi-step wizards.
You require advanced physics-based motion engines like Rive or Lottie.
strengths: Supports both solid colors and custom gradients.
Includes built-in animation components like ProgressBarAnimation and AnimatedProgressBar.
weaknesses: Limited to linear progress indicators only.
Very basic feature set compared to specialized animation suites.

alternatives.name: loading_animation_widget
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a variety of loading and progress indicator animations instead of just linear bars.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a comprehensive general-purpose animation library for custom widgets.
